welcome_greeting: Namaste. Welcome to SurakshaVani, the Cyber Crime Assistance and Golden-Hour Reporting Layer for Maharashtra.
disclaimer_prototype: IMPORTANT NOTICE: SurakshaVani is a citizen assistance intake layer designed to structure your complaint for the 1930 National Helpline, CFCFRMS, and Maharashtra Cyber Police. It is not an automated judicial court or irreversible FIR generator. For active life safety emergencies, immediately dial 112. For cyber financial fraud, official helpline is 1930.
dpdp_consent_notice:
PRIVACY & DATA PROTECTION NOTICE (DPDP Act 2023):
To structure your complaint and assist law enforcement in recovering funds, we process your voice recordings, phone number, and transaction details under strict end-to-end encryption. Your voice note is automatically purged after transcription. Data is securely retained only for authorized police review and CFCFRMS dispatch. You retain the right to withdraw consent or request erasure at any time.

Do you consent to proceed?
menu_title: How can SurakshaVani assist you today? Please choose an option:
fraud_voice_prompt:
Please describe what happened in your own words. You can speak freely in Marathi, Hindi, or English via a voice note, or type below.

Key details that help us freeze funds faster:
1. How much money was taken?
2. When did it happen?
3. Which bank or UPI was used?
4. The phone number or UPI of the suspect.
processing_indicator: Analyzing your report with high-fidelity speech recognition and entity extraction... Please wait a few seconds.
readback_header: Please review the structured summary of your complaint:
missing_field_prompt: To expedite the bank freeze on CFCFRMS, please provide the {field_name}. (You can reply with text or upload a screenshot of your payment receipt).
golden_hour_alert: ⚡ GOLDEN HOUR ACTIVE: Since this fraud occurred within the last 60 minutes, speed is critical to place a lien on the recipient bank account before cash withdrawal.
one_tap_1930_cta: 📞 Tap here to immediately connect with the 1930 Cyber Fraud Helpline with your pre-filled dossier: tel:1930
extortion_intro:
You are in a safe, confidential space. Please take a deep breath: You are NOT at fault. Online blackmailers and fraudsters rely on psychological panic, shame, and urgency to coerce victims.

CRITICAL SAFETY RULES:
1. DO NOT PAY any money. Paying never stops extortion; it only invites higher demands.
2. DO NOT DELETE chat history, voice notes, or phone numbers. They are vital forensic evidence.
3. Keep your social media profiles locked and private.
extortion_evidence_guidance: Please share screenshots of the chat, the blackmailer's phone number or social profile URL. All uploads are stored in an encrypted evidence vault.
nominee_setup_prompt: Protect your elders and family. Enter the mobile number of a trusted relative (son, daughter, spouse). If you ever report a financial scam, we will instantly send them an alert so they can support you.
nominee_setup_success: Family Nominee successfully registered! If an urgent complaint is filed from your number, an alert will be dispatched to your trusted contact.
nominee_alert_msg: URGENT SAFETY ALERT: Your family member ({reporter_phone}) has just reported a potential cyber financial fraud of ₹{amount} to SurakshaVani. Please check on them immediately and assist in calling 1930.
aftercare_steps:
IMMEDIATE AFTERCARE CHECKLIST:
1. Call your bank's official 24x7 fraud helpline to block your debit/credit card and internet banking credentials.
2. Do not respond to further calls or messages from the suspect.
3. Never share any OTP or approve collect requests.
4. Save copy of your bank account statement showing the unauthorized debit.
status_not_found: No active complaint found matching this phone number. Please verify your reference number or file a new report.
erasure_confirm_prompt:
Under Section 12 of the DPDP Act 2023, you have the right to erase your personal data. This will irreversibly remove your phone number, voice notes, and contact identifiers from our records.

Are you sure you wish to delete your data?
erasure_completed: Your personal data and identifiers have been permanently erased from SurakshaVani records. Reference records are de-identified for aggregate police statistics.
safety_escalate_msg:
We hear you, and please know that help is available right now. Your life and well-being are paramount. Please connect with caring counselors:
• National Mental Health Helpline (Tele-MANAS): Dial 14416 (Toll-Free, 24x7)
• Police Emergency: Dial 112
• iCall Psychosocial Helpline: 9152987821
An officer from Maharashtra Cyber has also been alerted to handle your situation with utmost discretion.
rate_limit_exceeded: You have reached the maximum allowed messages for this window. Please wait a few moments before trying again. For immediate fraud reporting, call 1930.
